messages:
maya: Heads-up — opening a docs PR to consolidate tiered consumption examples + the quota behaviour notes. Need a quick eyes-on from @jordan and @kevin before EOD. Draft: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/842

jordan: Quick Q — are we changing any header names in the SDK v3 snippets? I want the curl/python examples to show the real response headers for X-Rate-Limit and consumption units.

maya: Yes. Plan is to standardize on Authorization, X-Client-Id, and X-Consumption-Units in examples. Will add both curl and python sdkv3 snippets. Example for curl:```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "X-Client-Id: my-app" \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

sam: Can we also add a Grafana panel link so SRE can wire the dashboard? I can validate metric names if you drop the link.

maya: Adding panel link placeholder: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/consumption-panels — will replace with the real uid once SRE confirms.

kevin: Billing note: include a short callout that explains tier rollover and burst credits — customers keep using request path but accounting switches to next tier and then burst credits apply. Also add one explicit example for a 10M-tokens/month tier.

hannah: FYI I spotted a broken anchor in pricing.md ("#tier-assignment") while reviewing. I'll correct it in this PR so the anchor links to the new consolidated section.

jordan: I'll do a fast review now. Please ensure the SDK snippet uses the new header names and shows how to parse X-Consumption-Units from responses. A tiny example in Python would help:```python
resp = client.generate(prompt)
print(resp.headers.get('X-Consumption-Units'))
```

sam: I'll confirm the metric name on Monday. I think the query should use `sum(rate(redwood_consumption_units_total[5m])) by (tier)` — will validate and paste exact panel query in the PR once verified.

doc-bot: reminder: docs PR template requires: checklist (link check, snippet tests, ownership tag).

maya: Thanks all — I'll push the header/snippet changes + anchor fix in the next update. Ping me if you want a separate micro-PR for the Grafana panel link.

kevin: Sounds good. If billing has questions about wording, ping me before merge.

jordan: LGTM in principle. If CI for snippets passes I'll merge and backport to /v1 docs branch. :thumbsup:
